mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, content, type, related_id, is_read, create_time FROM notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY is_read ASC, create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (user_id, title, content, type, related_id, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{type}, #{relatedId}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET is_read = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE notification SET is_read = 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
